chapter: Carey band, jazz and drum demonstrations
title: Playing soft in the melody and loud on the last chorus
summary: Dropping down on the melody so the bass and banjo are heard, then everyone blasting the out chorus to swing the dancers; modern bands lack the contrast.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
